args.body: Take BUYER-PAID-FEED-RECONCILIATION. Check for equivalent work first. Within the existing three-capture allowance, prioritize an original current buyer request that explicitly pays for a standalone comparison of two non-personal files and invites a response. On a fit, run the existing supplier CSV comparer on a fictional pair tied to the buyer's actual acceptance wording. Save the command, outputs, original source quotation and hash. Use a copy-ready AI-disclosed proposal only if supplier eligibility, the invited response route and payment compatibility are supported. Otherwise preserve any tested sample and the precise reopening condition. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact or spending.
